title: Swinging card over a stepping feature list
summary: A tall all-caps list of one-word features steps down the square frame while a payment card swings to a new tilt and colour at each stop. One hero object plus a wall of capabilities, read in under 4 s.
use_when: A card, pass or badge product with many small capabilities to name at once
A short square loop for a feed, landing page hero or plan comparison
Silent autoplay where one object and single words carry the message
Showing several colour or tier variants of the same physical object

look.type_style: heavy grotesk, all caps, tight tracking, cap height about 8.5 % H, line pitch about 14 % H, centred stack of 7 lines; tiny sentence-case caption under the card about 1.5 % H

sfx.event: card settles at a list stop (3 per loop)

structure.shot: centred wall of 7 one-word features on pale grey; a card with a big wordmark covers the middle; 3 stops: deep blue, pale blue, black card
structure.camera: locked frame, no scale change (line pitch 67 px in cells 0.00 and 1.27); the list travels down 238-314 px/s @1920 during moves
structure.motion: 3 stops of about 38 fr: hold 15-22 fr, then list steps down 3-4 lines on easings.outExpo ~22 fr (±0.25 s) while the card swings to a new tilt (0°, about -12°, about +12°) and new colour on springs.heavy ~22 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); a tiny caption or icon chip shows near the card at each stop

params.brand: any brand.json: display font for the list, fg, bg, accent for the first card
params.content.features: 12-18 one-word capabilities, all caps, ≤ 10 letters each; the list wraps
params.content.cards: 3 card variants: background, wordmark colour, tilt in degrees (default 0, -12, +12)
params.content.captions: optional tiny line per stop under the card (tagline, credit line), ≤ 4 words
params.timing.stop: frames per stop at 30 fps (default 38), hold share about 45 %
params.timing.linesPerStep: lines the list advances per stop (default 3-4)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from one 4 fps sheet (no cuts, silent). Period about 1.26 s per stop, 3 stops in 3.77 s. List moves downward (new words enter from the top). Card covers about 50 % of the width and hides 2-3 words; its soft drop shadow is the only depth cue. Colour swap moment and any flip are not measurable at 0.25 s. Last cell (3.50) is still settling about 10 % off the first, so loopable is false by the rule, though the piece is built to loop. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): hero-swing-stop, step-scroll-list.
